name: Hunting for Ectoplasm
summary: Mux Manascrambler in Gadgetzan has his distiller ready, and now needs ectoplasm. You carry it to Silithus, Winterspring and the Eastern Plaguelands, gathering twelve of each kind from the incorporeal dead. This follows The Ectoplasmic Distiller.

sections.title: Three Climates, Three Kinds
sections.body:
Mux Manascrambler is proud of his distiller, but the incorporeal dead are far from Gadgetzan. He believes climate changes the spectral fabric of the dead. In Silithus, tortured night elves yield scorched ectoplasm. In Winterspring, spirits of the highborne yield frozen ectoplasm.

Ghosts and banshees in the Eastern Plaguelands yield stable ectoplasm. Gather twelve of each kind. Mux says to set the distiller down nearby before harvesting, then bring it and the ectoplasm back to Gadgetzan.

sections.title: Mux's Verdict
sections.body: Mux Manascrambler is delighted with the ectoplasm. Its otherworldly energies, he explains, will let you reach out to souls that have not fully left this world.

faq.q: Who sends you to gather ectoplasm?
faq.answer: Mux Manascrambler sends you from Gadgetzan in Tanaris once his distiller is built.

faq.q: Why does Mux need ectoplasm from three different places?
faq.answer: Mux says climate changes the spectral fabric of the dead. He wants twelve scorched ectoplasm from Silithus, twelve frozen from Winterspring and twelve stable from the Eastern Plaguelands.
Tortured night elves in Silithus, spirits of the highborne in Winterspring, and ghosts and banshees in the Eastern Plaguelands provide the ectoplasm.
Mux says to set the distiller down near the incorporeal dead before harvesting them.

faq.q: Where does this fit in Mux's work?
aliases: what comes before hunting for ectoplasm
faq.answer: It follows The Ectoplasmic Distiller, and A Portable Power Source comes next.
